subject: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluehaven.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options

Hi Ben / Procurement team,

Attaching a short consumption snapshot for May and a one-page latency summary — pulled the three highest-variance routes and token mix so we can align on economics. TL;DR: net token spend is up 32% year-over-year for your customer-facing assistants; average p50 latency improved 12% after the model swap (thanks for the rollout notes).

Two paths that usually make sense at this stage:
- Right-size commit (add 20% headroom) with a 12-month term extension to smooth pricing and avoid overage volatility.
- Keep current commit, add a short burst pool and credits for seasonal spikes (quarterly true-up).

Attachments: bluehaven-2028-05-usage.csv (csv), may-latency-summary.pdf (pdf)

Quick questions for the renewal call:
1) Are you looking for fixed monthly spend or flexible headroom?
2) Any procurement gating items we should prepare (e.g., SOW/PO timing)?

Happy to set a 30-min sync this week. Passing to Karthik and Monica for pricing/ops suggestions.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluehaven.ai>
Date: 2028-06-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options

Thanks Soojin — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications:

- The 32% YoY is accurate; main driver is increased assistant adoption in Care Ops.
- We prefer predictable monthly unit economics rather than ad-hoc overages.

Two asks from Procurement:
1) Can you provide pricing tiers if we move to +20% committed tokens vs +35%? We want the delta.
2) Would Redwood consider a 12-month term with a 60-day payment window (our standard)?

Also, our legal has previously asked about SLA credits for latency degradations. If we commit more, we'd like a simple SLA credit schedule for p95 > 1.2s.

I've attached a short forecast (bluehaven-forecast-q3.xlsx) with expected ramp by product team.

-Ben
Ben Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships | Bluehaven Analytics
ben.turner@bluehaven.ai

Looping in Karthik (AE) and Monica (Customer Success) to get pricing and operational input. Key asks from Ben: pricing for +20% vs +35% commit, 12-month term with 60-day payment, and a simple SLA credit schedule for p95 >1.2s.

Ben attached a Q3 forecast. Monica — can you validate the spike assumptions (Care Ops ramp) and whether we should recommend a short burst pool in lieu of higher commit? Karthik — happy to propose two commercial options for Ben to choose from.

Quoted below for context:
> On Tue, Jun 13, 2028 at 10:02 AM Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — useful summary...

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-16T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks for the data — below are two clean options that address predictability and headroom. Both assume the current model mix and the May baseline in Soojin's attachment. Pricing below is unit price per 1M tokens.

Option A — Conservative commit (20% increase)
- 12-month term
- Commit: current_commit * 1.20
- Unit price: $18 per 1M tokens
- Quarterly true-up (no additional overage beyond committed tokens within quarter)
- SLA credit: 5% credit for p95 > 1.2s (credit applied to next invoice)

Option B — Aggressive commit + burst credits (35% increase)
- 12-month term + 6-month optional extension at same rates
- Commit: current_commit * 1.35
- Unit price: $16.50 per 1M tokens
- Includes a burst pool of 250M tokens per quarter at $12 per 1M when used
- SLA credit: 8% credit for p95 > 1.2s and 12% for p95 > 1.8s

Additional notes:
- Payment terms: we can accept 60-day payment for Enterprise if procurement confirms PO cadence; we'll need a signed addendum.
- Deal ID: BH-2028-042. I can generate a formal addendum and DocuSign envelope once Ben indicates preferred option.

Marissa — can you confirm if we have capacity headroom on the Dedicated pool for Bluehaven for Q3?

Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options

Hi all,

Operational check on the forecast assumptions — validated the Care Ops ramp in rows 4-7 of the Q3 sheet. A few comments from CS/ops:
- We recommend Option A if Bluehaven prefers simpler monthly predictability. Option B is lower unit cost but requires the burst pool governance we outlined (burst tokens are drawn by product and reconciled monthly).
- Latency: P95 for your primary region (us-west) was 0.88s in May; we do see occasional peaks tied to nightly batch fan-in (we'll provide mitigation playbook).
- Capacity: Marissa confirmed there's capacity headroom; we can allocate a reserved buffer to avoid warm-up latency during spikes.

Next steps from our side:
1) We'll draft an addendum for Option A and Option B (two-sided comparison) with SLA credit language.
2) Karthik to include the 60-day payment term in the addendum if procurement confirms.
3) Schedule a renewal call — suggested slots: Jun 21 10:00am PT or Jun 22 2:00pm PT.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@bluehaven.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven renewal — consumption snapshot & scalable commit options

Appreciate the clear options. Bluehaven is leaning toward Option A to start (20% commit) — we value predictability while we stabilize Care Ops growth. Confirming: 12-month term, 60-day payment window, and the SLA credit schedule you outlined.

Please send the two-sided addendum and the DocuSign link for Option A. We'll aim to sign by Jul 5 and lock the commit for July usage.

Thanks everyone — book me the Jun 21 10:00am PT slot for the renewal call.

-Ben
